graph_scope: The settled graph includes 84 project sources and five configuration/equation pins. The only changes against its earlier graph were AnnotatedProofChecker and the target; the ten checker-affected prerequisites were rebuilt before the final four checks.
dependency_boundary: Other project dependencies and installed packages were precompiled and reused in an isolated overlay. These scoped checks do not constitute a clean full-project build.
archive_scope: Plain evidence files and original/final source snapshots only. Overlay links and object files are excluded; paths and hashes in receipts for objects describe historical or reused observations.
independent_review: The source change, proof, all 45 recorded command statuses and logs, graph and reused-object pins, and old/new axiom reports passed independent review.
